comparison.objective: Stow a nailer while maintaining safe pointing and trigger clearance; candidate extracts a connector terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Hazard-aware rigid-tool reorientation and possible handoff versus compliant wire positioning and precision blade-mediated latch release.
comparison.success_condition: Nailer rests on its case outline without pointing/trigger violations; candidate requires a correctly released terminal and no connector damage, with force thresholds still missing.
comparison.reason: Safe orientation planning does not test recessed latch access or coordinated depinning.
